definition: Designing and refining the input text given to a model to steer its output toward a desired result.
details: Because LLMs are controlled through their input, the wording, structure and examples in a prompt matter enormously. Practices include clear instructions, role framing, few-shot examples, chain-of-thought and output formatting. The DAIR.AI Prompt Engineering Guide is a widely used practical reference for these techniques.
story: Picture a novelist who has read so much that, given a first line, they cannot help but write the next one. Here is the short version: Designing and refining the input text given to a model to steer its output toward a desired result. The part that makes it sing: Because LLMs are controlled through their input, the wording, structure and examples in a prompt matter enormously. It is prediction pushed forward — each next word, or pixel, guessed from everything that came before it. And that is Prompt Engineering — making something new out of everything it has ever seen.
